Garden Design Service

Virtual Garden Design Service

Complimentary Consultation

Garden design is a crucial part of the service we offer.

We understand that for our clients gardening is a rewarding and enjoyable hobby that can bring a lot of benefits to your life. From growing your own vegetables and herbs to creating a beautiful outdoor space for relaxation and entertainment, gardening has something to offer everyone. However, before you start digging, clearing, and possibly planting, it’s important to have a clear idea of what you want your garden to look like. This is where garden design comes in.

Garden design is the process of planning and creating a garden layout that meets your aesthetic preferences and functional needs. It involves considering various elements such as the type of plants you want to grow, the layout of paths and structures, and the overall style of the garden.
//

Why garden design is important

Visualise your garden before we begin building it

This means that you can see how different elements will fit together and make any necessary changes before any work starts. By visualising your garden, you can also ensure that you create a cohesive and aesthetically pleasing design that suits your personal taste.

Helps you to make the most of your available space

Whether you have a small balcony or a large lawned space. By carefully planning the layout and choosing the right plants, you can create a garden that feels spacious and functional. This can also help you to make the most of any special features of your garden, such as a sunny spot or a shady corner.

Add value, making it more attractive to potential buyers

A beautiful and functional outdoor space can create a positive first impression and help to sell your home more quickly. Even if you’re not planning to sell your property anytime soon, a well-designed garden can still provide a great source of enjoyment for you and your family.

Garden design can save you time and money in the long run

By carefully planning your garden, you can avoid costly mistakes such as buying plants that don’t thrive in your climate or choosing the wrong type of soil. This can also help you to create a garden that requires less maintenance and watering, saving you time and effort in the long run.
//

Garden design is an important aspect of gardening.

The beauty of employing a professional garden design and build company means that we can take all the hassle out of the process and make it an enjoyable and creative experience, taking the time to plan your garden can help you to make the most of your available space and create a space that brings joy and relaxation to your life.
//

What is 3D garden design?

If you are considering a garden design for your outdoor area, you may be overwhelmed with the variety of designs available. From CAD drawn to 2D & 3D and now the more specialist 3D walkthrough garden design services, which is right for you

Each garden design option has its own benefits, but you’ll find it largely depends on your budget.

Although it’s the most expensive option, 3D garden design images and video walkthroughs provide three massive benefits to the planning and execution of your dream outdoor space.

3D garden designs are extremely effective at capturing the mood and atmosphere of your future outdoor space, as you get to ‘sit’ in your garden and actually visualise what it may look like.

For gardens that have multiple levels it really helps to see the design at different angles. For example, raised planters, level changes and steps, pergolas and structures etc. We can reproduce real materials into the designs so that you can see how they will work together, with realistic texture and colours.

All planting suggestions are added at the real height and create an authentic look. Trees and shrubs will all cast shadows, so the 3D garden designs will help show where they will fall.
